SQL Interview question: 

15. Find customers who placed more than 2 orders within any 3-day window.

SELECT DISTINCT o1.customer
FROM orders o1
JOIN orders o2 ON o1.customer = o2.customer 
 AND o2.order_date BETWEEN o1.order_date AND DATE_ADD(o1.order_date, INTERVAL 2 DAY)
GROUP BY o1.customer, o1.order_date
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id) > 2;
